Class MapSelectionScreen

java.lang.Object

gui.screens.MapSelectionScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class MapSelectionScreen extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
A JavaFX layout component representing the Map Selection screen.

This class extends BorderPane and organizes the navigation header (TopBar) and the grid of available levels (MapsHolder). It communicates with the global GameManager to determine which maps the player has unlocked and dynamically builds the UI to reflect that progression.

  • Constructor Details

    • MapSelectionScreen

      public MapSelectionScreen(SceneManager sceneManager)
      Constructs a new MapSelectionScreen.

      Initializes the BorderPane layout, sets up the top navigation bar, loads the map data from MapMaker, and populates the center grid with map panels based on the player's current unlock progress.

      Parameters:
      sceneManager - The global SceneManager used for navigation.

  • Method Details

    • refreshMapButtons

      public void refreshMapButtons()
      Refreshes the visual state of the map selection grid.

      This method clears the current map panels and rebuilds them. It should be called every time this screen is navigated to, ensuring that any newly unlocked maps (e.g., after beating a level) are correctly displayed as accessible.
